'''Su'ock Ytam''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], who lived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Ytam lived in [[TX-38]], an underground [[City/Legends|town]], where he worked in a [[MephitaPharma, Inc.]] chemical factory, as a chemist. However, when the factory closed and the town was abandoned, Ytam stayed behind and lived there by himself. When the [[Heroes of Cularin]] came to TX-38 during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], while trying to find the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nek Lawsirk]], they spoke to Ytam and he directed them to the factory.

==Personality and traits==
As a result of spending too much time around chemicals, Ytam became slightly mad. He was paranoid and had a short attention span.
